title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2024 · Fmge Mini Test 9

questions.stem: An intern was asked to give an intravenous injection to a vein in the cubital fossa. All the following are true about the cubital fossa, except _________.
questions.stemHtml: An intern was asked to give an intravenous injection to a vein in the cubital fossa. All the following are true about the cubital fossa, except _________.

options.label: B
options.text: Musculocutaneous nerve is one of the contents

options.label: C
options.text: Radial nerve enters the fossa laterally

options.label: D
options.text: Median cubital vein forms the roof
